extracted.intended_audience: authors and developers of systematic reviews and reporting guidelines; evidence synthesis researchers
extracted.subtask_description: A list and brief guidance on official PRISMA extensions that provide topic- or method-specific reporting guidance for systematic reviews, plus extensions under development and related reporting guidelines. Useful for authors preparing review reports and for developers proposing new PRISMA extensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Abstracts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension; one of several extensions that provide reporting guidance for reviews that address particular review questions or use particular data sources (e.g. diagnostic test accuracy, individual participant data). Click on the extension for more information.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Acupuncture
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension providing reporting guidance tailored to systematic reviews of acupuncture interventions. Part of the suite of extensions that cover reporting aspects not captured in the main PRISMA statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Children and Adolescents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension providing reporting guidance for systematic reviews focused on children and adolescent populations; covers reporting issues specific to these populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Chinese Herbal Medicines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension offering reporting guidance for systematic reviews of Chinese herbal medicine interventions, addressing intervention- and context-specific reporting needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Complex Interventions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension giving reporting guidance for systematic reviews of complex interventions, where components, interactions, and contexts require specific reporting considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-COSMIN for Outcome Measurement Instruments
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension aligned with COSMIN standards, providing reporting guidance when reviews concern outcome measurement instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Diagnostic Test Accuracy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension that provides reporting guidance for systematic reviews addressing diagnostic test accuracy — cited by the page as an example of an extension that addresses particular review questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-EcoEvo
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension intended for systematic reviews in ecology and evolutionary biology (EcoEvo), addressing domain-specific reporting needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Equity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension providing guidance on reporting health equity considerations in systematic reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Harms
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension focused on reporting harms/adverse effects in systematic reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Individual Participant Data
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension providing reporting guidance for systematic reviews that use individual participant data (IPD), mentioned as an example of extensions covering particular data sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Living Systematic Reviews
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension offering reporting guidance for living systematic reviews which are continually updated as new evidence becomes available.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Moxibustion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension providing reporting guidance tailored to systematic reviews of moxibustion interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Network Meta-Analyses
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension addressing reporting requirements for network meta-analyses (comparative effectiveness across multiple interventions).

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Protocols
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension giving guidance on reporting protocols for systematic reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Scoping Reviews
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension that provides reporting guidance for scoping reviews, which have different objectives and methods than systematic reviews of interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Search
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official PRISMA extension focused on reporting of search methods in systematic reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: SWiM
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A reporting guideline closely aligned with PRISMA; provides reporting guidance for systematic reviews of interventions in which alternative synthesis methods to meta-analysis of effect estimates are used.

rubrics_metrics.name: TIDieR-SRs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A reporting guideline closely aligned with PRISMA; provides guidance on intervention reporting in systematic reviews (extension of TIDieR for systematic reviews).

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extension for rapid reviews (under development)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA extension for rapid reviews (under development)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as an extension under development in collaboration with members of the PRISMA Executive to address reporting needs specific to rapid reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extension for systematic reviews of preclinical in vivo animal experiments (under development)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA extension for systematic reviews of preclinical in vivo animal experiments (under development)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An extension being developed to cover reporting of systematic reviews of preclinical in vivo animal studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extension for systematic reviews of artificial intelligence (AI) interventions (under development)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA extension for systematic reviews of artificial intelligence (AI) interventions (under development)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An extension under development to provide reporting guidance for systematic reviews that evaluate AI interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extension for qualitative evidence syntheses (under development)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA extension for qualitative evidence syntheses (under development)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An extension being developed to address reporting issues specific to qualitative evidence syntheses.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extension for systematic reviews using GRADE (under development)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA extension for systematic reviews using GRADE (under development)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An extension in development to align PRISMA reporting guidance with the use of GRADE in systematic reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extension for systematic reviews of prevalence (under development)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA extension for systematic reviews of prevalence (under development)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An extension being developed to provide reporting guidance for systematic reviews estimating prevalence.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extension for systematic reviews of health economic evaluations (under development)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA extension for systematic reviews of health economic evaluations (under development)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An extension under development to cover reporting considerations specific to systematic reviews of health economic evaluations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Update of PRISMA for network meta-analysis (planned)
rubrics_metrics.description: Update of PRISMA for network meta-analysis
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Planned update listed on the page to revise PRISMA guidance specifically for network meta-analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Update of PRISMA for scoping reviews (planned)
rubrics_metrics.description: Update of PRISMA for scoping reviews
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Planned update to the PRISMA guidance for scoping reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Update of PRISMA for systematic review protocols (planned)
rubrics_metrics.description: Update of PRISMA for systematic review protocols
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Planned update to PRISMA-Protocols guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partial update of PRISMA 2020 to incorporate guidance on use of AI tools in the systematic review process
rubrics_metrics.description: Partial update of PRISMA 2020 to incorporate guidance on use of AI tools in the systematic review process
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A partial update to PRISMA 2020 specifically to incorporate guidance on the use of AI tools during the systematic review process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing a new PRISMA extension (application process)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are interested in developing a new PRISMA 2020 extension, please complete the application form and email it to prismastatement@gmail.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should complete the application form and email it to the PRISMA Secretariat; the PRISMA Executive will consider proposals against the 'criteria for approving new PRISMA extensions' at their monthly meeting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Criteria for approving new PRISMA extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria for approving new PRISMA extensions (referenced)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The PRISMA Executive will consider extension proposals against specified criteria for approval (the page references these criteria but does not reproduce them). Proposers should expect evaluation of their application against those criteria at PRISMA Executive meetings.
